close_reason: python_test via helper + PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE; checkout-independent link tree; 4/4 hits same and second checkout.
description:
## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

python_test calls the shared helper through a prelude patch (project-relative paths, hazard P2), and sets `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` (hazard P5) (spec §4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An unchanged python_test is a hit on the second run, including in a second checkout
- [ ] Tests write no bytecode into the tree

## Blocked by

- turnkey-vnm.5
- turnkey-vnm.20

comments.text: Carried over from turnkey-vnm.20 via turnkey-vnm.4: Python now runs a store-path interpreter, so only its own site-packages is on sys.path. User site-packages ($HOME/.local/lib/python3.x) stay enabled until python_test calls the caching helper, which pins HOME=/homeless-shelter. Verify a cached python_test can't see them.

Cross-checkout note: the first attempt showed the Python tests missing in a second workspace. Diagnosed as link-tree symlinks computed from resolved paths (prelude/toolchain files in the Nix store, and differences in how buck2 materialized an artifact), fixed by nix/patches/prelude/0004-python-checkout-independent-links.patch. With the fix, the test inputs and action digests were identical across checkouts, and a clean rerun (fresh store, fresh workspace) hit 4/4. One intermediate run still reported 0 hits with identical digests; it had confounders on the main side (a forced re-run and a prelude cell switch between runs) and did not reproduce.

title: Python tests are cached
